discipline_dismissal_002.answer: Yes. Grounds: Commission of acts including sexual/physical abuse of minors, drug offenses, fraud, or crimes on school property. Notice: 45 days written notice for resignation; Superintendent notifies Commissioner of Education for termination-related acts. Hearing rights: Not discussed. Timelines: 45 days prior to school year for resignation; 10-day grace period for certificate renewal. Decision maker: Board of Trustees (termination), Superintendent (resignation/notification).
discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: The Superintendent shall notify the Commissioner of Education whenever a certified employee, including a paraprofessional, is terminated by action of the Board of Trustees and the termination is related to the individual's commission of an act, which involves: 1. Any form of sexual or physical abuse of a minor child
